messages.author: a5dd4fd16be2bca2
messages.subject: SQL variables quoted?
parts:
Hi.

If I run examples in http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/vignettes/databases.html with options(dplyr.show_sql = TRUE), I get SQL queries like this:

SELECT "Year", "Month", "DayofMonth", "DayOfWeek", "DepTime", "ArrTime", "UniqueCarrier", "FlightNum", "TailNum", "ActualElapsedTime", "AirTime", "ArrDelay", "DepDelay", "Origin", "Dest", "Distance", "TaxiIn", "TaxiOut", "Cancelled", "CancellationCode", "Diverted"
FROM "hflights"
LIMIT 10

Why is all the variables and table names quoted? The reason I'm asking is, I'm working on connecting dplyr to a SQL backend which does not understand quoted variable names, and there does not seem to be a way to turn this behavior off in a sql_variant.

BTW, thanks for the awesome package.

messages.author: a5dd4fd16be2bca2
messages.subject: Re: SQL variables quoted?
parts: After following the code more carefully, it turns out I need to define escape_ident for my case. Thanks.
